items.title: 14.6 S.H.M. ki graph ke zariye numaindagi (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the graphs of S.H.M. (PDF 31).

blocks.text: S.H.M. karne wale jism ka displacement, velocity aur acceleration waqt ke muqable graphs par dikhaye ja sakte hain (Fig 14.9).

items: Displacement: x = xo cos(wt) (14.19). Inteha ki jagahon par zarre ka zyada se zyada displacement xo hai.
Velocity: is ki miqdar xo w sin(wt) (14.20) hai; simt shamil karein to v = -xo w sin(wt). Raftar darmiyani jagah par zyada se zyada, xo w, aur intehaon par sifar hai.
Acceleration: a = -w^2 x; x = xo cos(wt) rakhne par a = -xo w^2 cos(wt) (14.21). Acceleration intehaon par zyada se zyada, xo w^2, aur darmiyani jagah par sifar hai.

blocks.text: Graphs se: velocity aur displacement ka phase farq pi/2 (chauthai chakkar) hai, aur acceleration aur displacement ka phase farq pi (aadha chakkar) hai, is liye acceleration hamesha displacement ke ulat hota hai.

blocks.title: Acceleration aur displacement mein pi ka farq
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke acceleration aur displacement ka phase farq pi/2 hai, aur displacement, velocity aur acceleration ka phase farq pi/2 hai. Kyunke a = -w^2 x, acceleration aur displacement bilkul ulat hain: un ka phase farq pi hai. Velocity in dono se pi/2 mukhtalif hai. Kitab ke velocity aur acceleration graphs bhi sifar se shuru hote hain, jo x = xo cos(wt) se nahi milte; dobara banaye graphs equations ke mutabiq hain.

blocks.alt: Aik period ke teen graphs, T/4, T/2, 3T/4 aur T nishan zada. Oopar, neela: x = xo cos(wt), +xo se shuru. Darmiyan, sabz: v = -xo w sin(wt), sifar se shuru ho kar pehle manfi. Neeche, surkh: a = -xo w^2 cos(wt), sab se manfi qeemat se shuru, displacement graph ka aaina-numa aks.
blocks.caption: S.H.M. mein displacement, velocity aur acceleration (Fig 14.9 ke mutabiq asal graphs).
blocks.long_description: Jahan x sab se zyada, wahan v sifar aur a ulti simt mein sab se zyada hai. Jahan x sifar, wahan raftar sab se zyada aur a sifar hai.

blocks.prompt: S.H.M. ke kin nuqton par (a) raftar aur (b) acceleration sab se zyada hain?
blocks.explanation: (a) Raftar darmiyani jagah par sab se zyada, xo w, hai. (b) Acceleration intehaon par sab se zyada, xo w^2, hai.

items: x = xo cos(wt); v = -xo w sin(wt); a = -xo w^2 cos(wt).
v aur x mein chauthai chakkar (pi/2); a, x ke ulat (pi).
